title: Who plays first on the green?
question: When players have their balls on the green, whose turn is it to putt first?

choices.text: Whoever is closer to the hole
Whoever is furthest from the hole
Whoever played their last shot first

explanation: On the green, the player whose ball is furthest from the hole plays first. This helps keep play fair and safe.

juniorVersion.title: Who putts first when you’re all on the green?
juniorVersion.question: If everyone’s balls are on the green, who should take their putt first?

choices.text: The person whose ball is closest to the hole
The person whose ball is the furthest from the hole
The person who hit their last shot first
Anyone who wants to go first

juniorVersion.explanation: The player who is the furthest away from the hole always putts first. This way, everyone gets a fair go and no one gets in the way.

vocabulary.simpleMeaning: The soft, smooth area around the hole where you putt.
A soft shot you make to roll the ball into the hole on the green.

juniorVersion.teachingTip: Show children how to tell which ball is furthest from the hole using footsteps on the green.
likelyMisconceptions: Some kids may think the closest player goes first because they are near the hole.
Kids might not realise you always check all balls before choosing who putts first.
